CommunityApplications.Profile:
DOOM, from the sources id Software released in 1997, built and run inside the container and played in a browser. The container brings its own X server and exports it over noVNC - nothing is needed on the host.
Sound effects and music come out of the browser, over the same port as the picture, with nothing to set up. The shareware game data is included, so it plays as soon as it starts; your own IWAD takes precedence when you add one. Commercial game data is not included and comes from your own copy of the game.
Keys and the mouse are configured from inside the game, under Options - Setup, which also lists the WAD files in the mounted folder and loads the one you pick, so mods can be added without changing the container.
Issues and questions go to the GitHub tracker linked below.
